labels.notes: Row stays partial and unmarked (module docstring l.12-14: 'partial (unmarked ...', no bold module mark), correct since isCausalLine_iff's 'if' still rests on not_hasHighDegreeAt. git diff HEAD of HSCausal.lean: removed lines are only docstring text, the old not_hasCCC_of_deSitter header/docstring and its two tagged sorrys. No definition hunk: DSLe, IsFutureCausalCurve, HasCCC, IsCausal, IsCausalLine are untouched (hunks at l.3-114 are module docstring, l.1182+ is the new section 7b insertion, l.1848-1893 are the deSitter/not_hasCCC/iff block). not_hasCCC_of_deSitter's #check signature is identical to HEAD (Δ, hp : C.pt ∈ HS.piece 2 .deSitter, h₁ : linkType ≠ misner, ¬ IsHighDegree → ¬ HasCCC); only the degree binder renamed _h₂. New statements: not_hasCCC_of_spacelike (every b, every k, from C.HasType (.spacelike b k); k ≥ 1 is extracted from HasType, not assumed), not_hasCCC_of_trivialHolonomy (every k; k ≠ 0 derived), not_hasCCC_of_future_past, not_hasCCC_of_surjective, not_hasCCC_of_deSitter_of_ne_misner (no degree hypothesis). hasCCC_iff_misner: ∀ Δ : C.DevData, HasCCC ↔ linkType = misner, no extra hypothesis, for every (Γ_p, ℓ(p))-circle C; not vacuous: the ← direction is the pre-existing hasCCC_of_misner (a genuine nonconstant CCC, HasCCC requires γ r₁ ≠ γ r₂), DevData is nonempty (nonempty_devData), and the → direction covers all three regions by trichotomy of minkQ. Findings checked: the paper's list (l.1120-1125) excludes only space-like/light-like degree ≥ 4 and Misner, so tachyons (space-like, degree 2) are implicitly asserted causal without argument; the Lean proves no CCC for every space-like degree k ≥ 1 and every trivial holonomy, which is stronger than printed, and the 'independence' reading (CCC clause excludes exactly Misner, degree clause exactly degree ≥ 4) follows from hasCCC_iff_misner. True as stated.
